subject: Example of multiple methods in same doc please

messages.author: e6e8f1599045358d
messages.subject: Example of multiple methods in same doc please
parts:
I have some code like

#' An S4 method
#'
#' Its description
#'
#' @param x object
#'
#' @rdname foo
#' @export
setMethod('theMethod', 'class1', function(x) bar(x))

#' @rdname foo
#' @export
setMethod('theMethod', 'class2', function(x) bar(x))

and so on.

This worked with v3 but broke with v4 (or at least I suspect so -- the error messages are not in the least helpful). Is this acceptable roxygen2? Is there anywhere an exact description of what is required and allowable?

THK

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Example of multiple methods in same doc please
parts:
The problem was this:

signature(object = "ANY", SRS = "NULL"),
function(object, SRS)
{
# warning("SRS not set; input SRS is NULL")
object
})

I hadn't anticipated that you'd have an S4 method that just returned
an object. I've fixed the bug and it now works in the dev version of
roxygen :)

Hadley
